answer.description: If no code work is needed: the complete answer for the user, in Spanish. Otherwise: a one-paragraph summary of the plan, in Spanish.

needs_user_input.description: A question the user must answer before any step can run. Empty string if none.

deep_orchestration_reason.description: Empty string normally. Non-empty ONLY if planning this request itself needs the deep-reasoning model (see escalation rules for orchestrate): cite the trigger id and one sentence.

steps.description: Ordered steps. Empty if `answer` fully resolves the request or if `needs_user_input` is set. As few steps as possible.

level.description: light = trivial (rename, one line, config value). normal = default. deep = needs the deep-reasoning model; only allowed for architect/research/review/verify and only when an escalation trigger applies.

reason.description: Required when level is deep: the trigger id (G1..G5) and one sentence. Empty otherwise.

instruction.description: Self-contained instruction for that layer, in Spanish: exact file paths, exact change, acceptance criteria.
